title: Korea prepares to host half a million young pilgrims in Seoul for World Youth Day
caption:
In 2027, South Korea will host World Youth Day, marking the first time this global gathering takes place in a non-Christian-majority country. Authorities are using AI and military facilities to manage the half a million expected attendees.

Source: Koreaherald - Korea prepares to host half a million young pilgrims in Seoul for World Youth Day
